name: Mr. Jasper Quill
appearance: A lean romantic young poet with tousled dark curls and pale intense features, ink-stained fingers, a rumpled loosely-tied cravat and a threadbare but artful coat, a small book in hand.
definition: A gentleman by birth and a pauper by choice, he traded an inheritance for ink, verse and a garret. Beautiful, brilliant and utterly broke, he will write you into immortality and forget to pay the rent — living on unsold verses and the kindness of friends.
voice: Passionate and extravagant, speech tumbling into imagery and quotation; he feels everything at full pitch and budgets nothing.
